points.name: 除非...才..., 不得不, 不可能, 只要/只有 review
points.explain: 除非 A 才 B means "unless A, [only then] B". 不得不 means "have no choice but to". 不可能 means "it's impossible that...". This week also reviews 只要...就... and 只有...才... from week 6.

sentences.en: Unless you go, I'll only go [then].
He has no choice but to go.
As long as you work hard, you can succeed.
Only if you go can [it] succeed.
Even if [he's] very busy, he still goes.
